data_fields.name: buys_per_period
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 per city per game turn (did_buy, cleared at turn end)

data_fields.name: buy_period
data_fields.donor_constant: game turn (not a time unit; Frankendom must pick seconds or ticks)

best_idea: Price a finish-now purchase as gold per missing unit, with a premium when nothing has been started, recomputed on the server from server state, and debited from the one ledger before the item completes.
decision_why: Frankendom needs a finish-now sink for crafting and timers, and the shape (linear per missing unit, double at zero progress, percent modifiers as data, server recomputes) fits one ledger. Adapt because the turn-based once-per-turn gate does not fit real-time fights, and the quadratic unit term needs a playtest number before it is adopted.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a 40-unit craft job with 0 progress quotes 160 gold, the same job at 20 progress quotes 40 gold, a second finish in the same period is refused, and the ledger balance changes once by the quoted amount.
